title: The Legend of Ansur
summary: Reveals the way to Ansur beneath Wyrm’s Rock.

fields.Wyrmway: The instructions reveal the hidden passage in Wyrm’s Rock Prison. Deal Lightning damage to the two dragon-head torches at the entrance to open it.
fields.Acquisition: Ulder Ravengard can give it if he survived the Iron Throne and Wyll is present as party member or camp follower.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
